title: Formie 4 markup hooks and form styles
description: Prepares the frontend for Formie 4, and keeps it working on Formie 3: the Formie JS component also starts on Formie 4's data-formie-form attribute, labels with the position Hidden stay visually hidden (data-formie-sr-only), input.has-error wins over the base input styles again, and the form templates render with theme 'none' (Formie 4 then only loads its 3 KB base CSS). The Formie upgrade itself and config/formie.php are manual steps, see the changelog.
